parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain name to query. You can specify multiple domain names separated by commas (,).

If you leave this parameter empty, data for all your accelerated domain names is returned.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description:
The name of the rule.

- Normal mode: default\_normal

- Emergency mode: default\_attack

- Custom mode: a custom rule name, such as test2.

If you leave this parameter empty, all block events are queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes.

If you do not specify this parameter, data from the last 24 hours is returned.

parameters.name: TriggerObject
parameters.description:
The object that triggers the rate limiting rule.

If you leave this parameter empty, all block events are queried.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description:
The value of the trigger object.

If you leave this parameter empty, all block events are queried.
